title: Surreal Forest Path
description: A person sees a dark path with black and white checkered floor leading into a misty forest of bare trees. The scene has large dripping red and dark shapes hanging from the top and sides like torn curtains or paint.
prompt: surreal painting of a dark path with black and white checkered floor leading into a misty forest of bare leafless trees. large dripping red paint shapes and dark torn curtain like forms hang from the top and sides of the image. the forest fades into blue mist in the distance with some twisted trees on the sides.
